gui_forms::ToolTip.summary: ToolTip is the Windows Forms way to set tooltip text and timing over GUI.Forms' own tooltips: it presents nothing itself. set_tool_tip writes the target's Control::tool_tip_text, and the window's single tooltip presenter shows it; the delays, width and policies are the window's ToolTipSettings, shared by every ToolTip of that window.
remarks: Writes and clears `Control::tool_tip_text` on live controls of its window, and remembers which targets it set, so that `remove_tool_tip`, `clear` and disposal clear only its own text.
The timing and policy getters and setters read and write the window's `ToolTipSettings` field by field; the last value set by any ToolTip of the window holds.
`show` and `hide` drive the window's presenter (`Window::show_tool_tip`) for this ToolTip's targets; `visibility_changed` reports the window's tooltips for those targets.
Every operation throws `std::logic_error` once the ToolTip is disposed or its window is gone. Title, icon and balloon variants remain open.
gui_forms::ToolTip.ownership: A nonvisual `Component`. The application owns it directly or through a `ComponentContainer`; it binds to one Window and never becomes part of the visual tree. It observes its targets and never owns them. Disposal clears the text it set and disconnects its window subscription.
gui_forms::ToolTip.threading: UI-thread affine. Read and mutate on the owning Window's UI thread; wrong-thread mutation is rejected by the Window access guards (`Window::check_access` and `Window::verify_access`). The type is not internally synchronized.
gui_forms::ToolTip.availability: Renderer-neutral core (`gui_forms_controls`). Available wherever the GUI.Forms core builds: the macOS AppKit host, the Windows Win32 host, and the opt-in Linux X11 host. The public API is not yet stable.

gui_forms::ToolTip::ToolTip|void (Window.summary: Binds the provider to one live Window and subscribes to that window's tooltip visibility changes.

gui_forms::ToolTip::~ToolTip|void () noe.summary: Disposes the provider: clears the text it set and disconnects its window subscription.

gui_forms::ToolTip::set_tool_tip|void (c.summary: Writes the target's Control::tool_tip_text and records the target; empty text removes it. Rejects a target that is not a live control of this window, or text that is not valid UTF-8.

gui_forms::ToolTip::tool_tip|std::string.summary: Returns the target's tooltip text, whoever set it.

gui_forms::ToolTip::remove_tool_tip|bool.summary: Clears the text this ToolTip set on the target; returns false and changes nothing when it set none there.

gui_forms::ToolTip::clear|void ().summary: Clears the text this ToolTip set on every target.

gui_forms::ToolTip::show|void (const std.summary: Shows the target's tooltip at once, below it, for the auto-pop delay. Rejects a target this ToolTip set no text on.
Shows the target's tooltip at once, below it, for `duration` (zero: until hidden). Rejects a target this ToolTip set no text on.

gui_forms::ToolTip::hide|void ().summary: Closes the window's tooltip when it shows one of this ToolTip's targets.

gui_forms::ToolTip::visible|bool () cons.summary: Reports whether the window's tooltip shows one of this ToolTip's targets.

gui_forms::ToolTip::active_control|std::.summary: Returns this ToolTip's target whose tooltip the window shows, if any.

gui_forms::ToolTip::visibility_changed|E.summary: Returns the event that reports the window's tooltips opening and closing for this ToolTip's targets.
